candidates.description: This feature vector activates on words, suffixes, and roots related to resolution, transformation, and revolution across multiple languages.
This vector activates strongly for Roman numerals representing numbers.
This vector activates on word fragments and abbreviations starting with the letters "De" or "Dé".
This feature vector represents the root morphemes, prefixes, and suffixes common to institutional, constitutional, and individual-related vocabulary across Romance languages and English.
This feature vector represents words and roots related to military conflict, war, and related historical or geographical terms.
This feature vector represents terms associated with historical European nobility, architecture, and socio-political classes.
This vector represents the French letter 'é' (acute-accented e), often appearing at the beginning or within words.
This feature vector activates on common English and French word prefixes and initial root segments starting with the letters "re" or "ré".
This vector activates on tokens containing the substring "alt" or its close variations across different casing and languages.
These tokens represent the manner, speed, or mode in which an action or transition occurs.
